turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation?}

    B -->|ASSAY: received document| C[Read document]
    C --> D[Compress to floor content]
    D --> E[Name evaporated content]
    E --> F[Locate operative sentence]
    F --> G[Report ratio, direction, and missing rough edge]
    G --> H["Output Residue / Evaporated / Operative sentence / Finding"]
    H --> I["This is a finding, not a draft."]

    B -->|PROVIDE: draft prompt| J{Mode stated or inferable?}
    J -->|No| K[Ask for mode]
    K --> J
    J -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| L[Check Audience / Scope / Format / Path]
    L --> M{Floor passes?}
    M -->|No gaps| N[Ask up to three questions]
    M -->|Four or more gaps| O[Ask three largest questions]
    O --> P[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    N --> Q[Wait for answers]
    P --> Q
    Q --> L
    M -->|Yes| R[Compress the prompt]
    R --> S{Did the cut remove specification?}
    S -->|Yes| T[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    T --> U[Revert to last passing version]
    U --> R
    S -->|No| V{Two empty cuts in sequence?}
    V -->|No| W{Floor still passes?}
    W -->|No| U
    W -->|Yes| R
    V -->|Yes| X[Declare the contract minimal]
    X --> Y[Output optimized prompt and Cut line]
    R --> Y
    Y --> Z{Human freezes the full contract?}
    Z -->|No| R
    Z -->|Yes| AA{Execution tools available?}
    AA -->|No| AB[Keep gate closed]
    AA -->|Yes| AC[Freeze contract and execute exactly]
    AC --> AD{Execution result}
    AD -->|Success| AE[Complete]
    AD -->|Floor failure| AF[Name failed item and reopen contract]
    AF --> R
```
